comment: Weapon animation sets played by the operative's native weapon layer (UOperativeAnimInstance, OperativeAnimInstanceShotgun.cpp; designer decision 21, 2026-11-03: the D-1 shotgun switches the locomotion / aim set to the user's /Game/ShotgunLocomotionPack - never modified, read here by path). Directions clockwise from forward. *_speed = the loops' authored ground speed, cm/s (the play rate follows the actual speed). retargeted = skeleton name -> the folder of its IK-retargeted copies (same clip names; Scripts/Editor/setup_shotgun_animation.py; skeletons not listed - the PMC operator, Manny hierarchy - play the pack clips). reload: ONE pass of the pack's single reload clip on the upper body (designer 2026-11-08: restarting it x4.8 per shell shook him) - the intro 0 .. reload_shell_start_s once, the shell-insertion loop reload_shell_start_s .. reload_shell_end_s once per shell (rate = loop length / the per-shell step, kept 0.7..1.4), then the outro from reload_outro_start_s (the loop's end pose) to the clip's end; measured by Scripts/Editor/measure_shotgun_reload.py (the left hand at the loading port, the same pose at 0.833 / 1.2 / 1.833 s). body (default "upper"): "upper" = the set drives spine_01 and below, the pelvis / legs stay the ABP's rifle locomotion (the pistol); "full" = every bone but the root (the shotgun since the designer's 2026-11-09 b: the pack's Loop_Root legs, speed-matched per direction).

shotgun.comment: The D-1 shotgun, FULL BODY on the pack's root-motion loops (the game designer 2026-11-09 b: 'In /Game/ShotgunLocomotionPack/Animations/Loop_Root there are the animations to set up the shotgun locomotion'): walk 7 directions (the pack has no walk_45_fwd_right root clip: forward-right blends forward + right), aim walk / jog 8, crouch 4, sprint - all *_loop_root; idles from Idle/, turn in place from TurnInPlace/ (the clips turn 90 deg in their root: played by the body's own turn, feet planted), the pose aim offset from AimOffset/ (single-frame poses against front_C: yaw +-90, pitch +-75). The capsule moves the body (no root motion): the root stays the ABP's (the clips' root travel is dropped - no drift, no seam pop), each loop plays at speed / its natural speed (*_speeds = the root clips' measured root travel / length, Scripts/Editor/measure_shotgun_loop_root.py; x stride_scale for the retargeted copies: the IK retarget scales the root travel by the body's height, measured male x1.094 / female x1.018, the pelvis stays put on the root). Walk -> jog by speed over jog_blend_speeds (280 -> 360 cm/s: the operative's 220 cm/s walk plays the walk loops at ~x1.3, no long walk / jog mix), sprint when sprinting (the phase follows the blended cycle distance, so a mix keeps its feet), aim walk while aiming. Fire / reload unchanged (the reload natively on the upper body; the fire clip a montage: the legs stay the pack's - mask LowerBody).
shotgun.legs_abp_comment: The game designer 2026-11-10: any operative with the shotgun WALKS on the shotgun pack (full body, as before) and RUNS / SPRINTS on the M16 (ABP) legs with the shotgun upper body; the run share follows the pack walk -> jog band (jog_blend_speeds 280 -> 360).
shotgun.direction_comment: FormationJitterSmoke 2026-11-09 (the designer: the D-1 follower twitches / spins in the formation): the full-body legs follow the movement direction eased over direction_smooth_s (a follower correcting his slot swings it back and forth; a dead zone - direction_dead_zone_deg - left the legs off the travel: ShotgunSmoke 2b's planted foot slid 27 %, so 0), and a change of more than direction_snap_deg (a reversal) cross-fades the directional clips over direction_fade_s instead of sweeping through the strafes (their hips stand ~90 deg off the forward / backward ones). WeaponLayerHandoffRules::StepLayerDirection. torso_follows_forward: the chest keeps the yaw of the gait's forward clip at the same phase in every direction (the pack's directional clips twist it -27 .. +16 deg off the body, the ABP's rifle legs within +-6; FOperativeAnimInstanceProxy::StabilizeWeaponTorso). The clip weights (idle / walk / jog / turn in place) of a full-body set follow the ABP's smoothed speed (LocomotionSpeed): a follower hunting 0 .. 60 cm/s at his slot flicked the body between the idle and the walk.
shotgun.handoff_comment: The game designer's play-test 2026-11-09: crouched (crouch idle and crouch walk in every direction) the WHOLE body is the ABP's crouch locomotion - the same as the M16 squad members - and the whole cover mechanics (pressed to the wall standing / low, sliding along it, the corner peek and its fire pose, the run-and-peek, the corner holds, the shot off the wall, the last cover_approach_abp_cm of the walk / run to the cover slot) are the ABP's: the layer blends out / in over blend_seconds (WeaponLayerHandoffRules). The D-1 fire clip and the per-shell reload still play over the ABP pose. The crouch_* loops / turns stay listed (unused while crouch is abp).

pistol.comment: The pistol (the whole pistol, 2026-11-08): relaxed carry = the user's Fab pack 'Pistol and Rifle Locomotion Animations 1700' (GASP loops, imported from the launcher's vault cache onto the project's UE5 mannequin by Scripts/Editor/setup_pistol_animation.py -> /Game/Characters/Animations/Pistol/Source; the pack has no aim / fire / reload / equip), aimed = the Lyra mannequin pistol set already in the project (/Game/Characters/Mannequins/Anims/Pistol; MM_Pistol_Fire is a mesh-space additive recoil, played natively over the layer). The squad's UE4 skeletons play the IK-retargeted copies (retargeted); the reload clip (2.0 s) is fitted to the pistol's reload time.

launcher.comment: The RPG-7 (the game designer's launcher pack /Game/Launcher_Animations, 2026-11-09; the pack is the user's - never modified, read here by path): body "full" (the designer 2026-11-09 b: the pack's legs too - flip to "upper" for the torso only on the ABP's legs); legs_abp (the designer 2026-11-10): the gaits whose LOWER body is the ABP's M16 locomotion (as "upper") - run = the jog loops (any direction), sprint = Set_01 Run_Fast, walk_forward = the forward clip's share of the walk's direction blend (walk = every walk direction), blended by those gaits' clip weight and eased over blend_seconds, so forward -> strafe fades with the eased direction; legs_abp_forward_cone_deg 35 = walk_forward counts fully within 35 deg of straight ahead and fades to 0 at 90 (a leader under a formation look sector walks ~22 deg / at most 35 deg off his path, RpgAnimSmoke 2026-11-10 - at the bare blend weight his legs were 2/3 the ABP's, 1/3 the pack's, and the two unsynced leg sets slid the most); legs_abp_run_speeds [120, 160] = run counts by its own band (he runs ~175 cm/s with the tube, inside the clips' 140 -> 180 jog band: at the jog share 12 % of the pack's strafe legs stayed mixed in and slid); the torso keeps the pack's pose facing the capsule; idle, turn in place, walking sideways / backwards keep the pack's legs; drop the key for the pack's legs in every gait: every bone but the root from the pack, the in-place loops played at speed / their authored speed per direction (walk_speeds / jog_speeds / crouch_speeds / sprint_speed = the planted ball-of-the-foot speed of the MALE retargeted copies, measured at 240 Hz - the pack's *_Root variants' root travel does not match their feet, e.g. Walk_Right 150 cm/s of root travel vs 77 of planted foot; the *_Root clips are not used, the capsule moves the body; crouch_body upper: crouched, only the torso is the pack's - its crouch walk shuffles the feet (they slid 76 % of the speed, RpgAnimSmoke), the legs are the ABP's crouch; root_translation reference: the root is the reference pose's - translation too: on the ABP's lowered crouch root the pack's crouch feet sank ~8 cm), max_play_rate 2.4 so the sprint keeps its feet; phase_offsets = each loop's left heel strike (the left ball's farthest point along the travel, as a share of the loop, measured on the male copies at 240 Hz: the pack's loops are NOT phase-aligned - forward / right 0, back / left ~0.5, run right 0.125, run left 0.38), so a direction blend plants the same foot; stride_scale = the female copies' feet against the male (x0.945, measured); walk -> run over jog_blend_speeds 140 -> 180 (his 220 cm/s = the run loops at ~x1.2); the shot / reload take the torso only, the legs keep walking. Set_02 = the launcher on the shoulder (idle, walk / run 4 directions, crouch idle + crouch walk 4 directions, the shot, the reload, the aim-offset poses, hits, deaths); Set_01 = a lowered carry: only its Run_Fast is used (the sprint, nobody sprints with the tube shouldered). The squad's UE4 skeletons play IK-retargeted copies (retargeted; Scripts/Editor/setup_launcher_animation.py, the same UE4 rig both ways). pack_playback false: a skeleton with no copies gets no launcher layer at all (the PMC operator HAS copies since 2026-11-09, feat/rpg-ai-pmc: /Game/Characters/Animations/Launcher/Pmc, IK-retargeted UE4 -> UE5 onto SKM_PmcOperator by the same script) (the pack is a UE4 mannequin: by bone name it would bend a UE5 body). fire_* play natively on the upper body (the kick starts on frame 0, measured: the rocket leaves at the trigger, no delay); reload_* fit the weapon's reload_time after the shot's follow-through (reload_insert_s = the clip time the left hand pushes the rocket onto the tube - the rocket on the model shows from there; measured by setup_launcher_animation.py); aim_poses = the last frame of the Rotation_90_* clips against their first (the shouldered idle), mesh-space additives on a 3 x 3 grid at aim_yaw_range_deg / aim_pitch_range_deg (measured: left -91.5 / right +88.8 deg yaw, up +85.8 / down -89 deg pitch); the corners are the sums of the edges - the pack's Rotation_45_* poses (aim_poses_diagonals: retargeted, NOT used) were measured off the grid's corners (up-left -74 / +35, up-right +58 / +33, down-left -95 / -55, down-right +89 / -50 deg), so they would aim wrong there; hits = the upper-body hit reaction, deaths = the standing death (front hit -> deaths[0] falls backwards, from behind -> deaths[1] falls forwards). turn_* = turn in place standing still: the clips turn 90 deg in their root (dropped), so their time follows the body's own yaw (the feet stay planted).

prone_crawl.comment: The prone crawl (the game designer's CrawlAndShoot_Bug_01, 2026-11-09, fix/prone-crawl-under-fire; the pack /Game/Crawl_MocapAnimPack is the user's - never modified, read here by path): NOT a weapon - a native full-body layer over ABP_Operative's prone pose for every weapon while he crawls on an order / moves prone (OperativeAnimInstanceProneCrawl.cpp, ProneCrawlRules). The body (capsule) faces the threat, the 8 in-place loops play the move direction relative to it (strafe-crawl); root_translation reference: the root keeps the reference pose (the ABP's prone root yaw would turn the body off the threat). The squad's UE4 skeletons play IK-retargeted copies (retargeted; Scripts/Editor/setup_crawl_animation.py, the same UE4 rig both ways, measured 2026-11-10: posture within 9.5 cm male / 16.1 cm female, pelvis drift 0); pack_playback false (the PMC operator's UE5 body gets no crawl layer). walk_speeds = the pack's root-motion twins' travel (Loco_Linear_root, F / B 20.7, L / R 29.4, 45R / 135L 25.9, 45L / 135R 21.3 cm/s) x the male copies' measured stride 0.913 (their planted limbs against the pack's); stride_scale female 0.896 / 0.913 = 0.981; phase_offsets = each loop's left-hand reach (hand_l furthest along the travel, share of the loop, male copies) so a direction blend plants the same hand; play rate = speed / the blended authored speed, max_play_rate 3.5 (the crawl at ~0.28 x walk speed plays the loops at ~2-3x).

injured.comment: The injured locomotion (the game designer 2026-11-10: a wounded operative walks visibly injured; the pack /Game/CON_Injured is his - never modified, read here by path): NOT a weapon - a native layer over ABP_Operative on the LOWER body only (root -> the reference, pelvis, legs, foot IK bones; OperativeAnimInstanceInjured.cpp, InjuredLocomotionRules). Upper body: the clips are UNARMED (measured, Scripts/Editor/setup_injured_animation.py: the left hand held on the torso ~21 cm from the spine - the wound - the right arm hanging ~34 cm out), so the torso keeps the ABP's / the weapon layer's mesh-space pose (the weapon, the aim, fire / reload / grenade / blizzard clips); torso_pelvis_share 0.3 of the injured pelvis's rotation rides along when not aiming (0 while aiming). triggers: wounded (IsWounded, HP < 50 %) = the 8-direction walk (Walk_Injured_BS clips, the velocity relative to the body) + stand_idle; prone = the prone crawl layer plays crawl / crawl_idle in its forward slot; the cold (the designer 2026-11-10): Freezing cold_from 0.7 = walking plays the same 8-direction injured walk (~0.6x at its 99 cm/s), Frostbite cold_slow_from 0.9 = slow_walk by slow_forward_cone_deg [full, zero] (the injured walk outside it; ~1.4x at its 55 cm/s), standing still = the existing shiver idle (the layer is off) - this replaces the ABP's empty ColdWalkClips tiers; wounded first. The squad's UE4 skeletons play IK-retargeted copies (retargeted; the same UE4 rig both ways like the crawl; measured 2026-11-10: posture within 7.8 cm male / 13.4 cm female, pelvis drift <= 1.9 cm); pack_playback false (the PMC operator's UE5 body: no injured layer - the pack's UE5 set is not wired). fwd / bwd walk_speeds, slow_walk_speed, crawl_speed = each pack loop's best speed (cm/s: the ground speed at which its best-planted contact - the slowest of heels / balls, the crawl's hands / knees / balls - moves least, median over the loop; each loop = 1 gait cycle, 1.07 s; own slide there: forward / back 10-14 %, the slow walk 9 % - its root-motion twin travels 40.3, its feet fit 35.3 - the crawl 8 %, 63.0 vs Crawl_Injured_RM's 53.3); the diagonals / strafes were tuned in game on the copies (InjuredLocomotionSmoke, 3 probes each 2026-11-10: the script's 110-124 slid 40-50 %, the best of 110 / 135 / 150 / 160 / 185 kept per leg): their stance foot pivots, so they slide ~29-38 % at ANY play rate (own slide on the copies 25-38 %) - the clips' limit, not the layer's; direction_clip_band_deg 10 = within 10 deg of a clip it plays alone; stride_scale = the copies' planted-foot speed / the pack's (male 1.091, female 1.035, walk median), crawl_stride_scale male 0.972, female 0.998; phase_offsets = each loop's left heel strike (share of the loop, male copies; the crawl = its left-hand reach). Play rate = the body's speed / the blended authored speed: wounded 143 cm/s on the copies' 120-175 cm/s loops = ~0.8-1.2x; the slow walk only from Frostbite (55 cm/s on 38.5 cm/s = ~1.4x; at the freezing speed it would have needed ~2.6x - the designer chose the injured walk there 2026-11-10); slow_max_play_rate 2.8.
injured.limp_comment: The torso LIMP CUE (bug 2026-11-10, fix/injured-layer-visible: from the game camera - ~26 m, pitch -35, the body ~100 px tall - the lower-body injured walk under the upright rifle torso did not read; InjuredLocomotionDepotSmoke frames). On top of the layer the whole torso bends about the pelvis: hunch_deg forward (standing and walking, by the layer weight), sway_deg sideways once per gait cycle (a limp leans once a cycle; sway_phase = the share of the cycle, after the left heel strike, where the lean peaks), both x aiming_scale while aiming (the gun dips / rolls a little, the aim yaw is untouched). enabled false = the clips alone (InjuredLocomotionRules::FInjuredLimpCue).
